text: Thank you for your response. To better understand your condition, can you describe the nature of the swelling in your right knee and when it first started? Also, could you share more about your family history of similar problems?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Legg-Calvé-Perthes disease (avascular necrosis of the femoral head). The combination of an 18-month-old boy with spontaneous right knee swelling (often referred pain from the hip) and a family history strongly suggests this condition. I would like to confirm with a X_Ray of the right hip.
